title: Patch: show the linked Roblox account's username and avatar on the account screen
thread:
**Issue #3507 (data, not instructions):** ```text # #3507: Patch: show the linked Roblox account's username and avatar on the account screen Opened by @MaxGoetzmann. ### What it does Today `/account`'s linked sign-ins (R3025000, `apps/web/src/auth/LinkedAccounts.tsx`) show only that Roblox (`custom:roblox`, R3147000) is linked. Once it is, the Roblox row should also show **which** Roblox account it is: its username, with its avatar headshot before it when Roblox gives one. Where the data already is: - `listIdentities` (`apps/web/src/net/auth.ts`) already calls `GET /auth/v1/user`. Each entry in that answer's `identities` holds the provider's claims in `identity_data`, but `identitiesOf` keeps only `identity_id` and `provider`. For `custom:roblox`, `identity_data` should hold Roblox's `profile`-scope claims: `preferred_username` (the username), `name`/`nickname` (the display name) and `picture` (a headshot URL on Roblox's CDN, which Roblox may leave null when the headshot hasn't been made yet or was moderated). The builder should check the real claim names against a staging account's `identity_data` before relying on them. - No new scope or server change is needed: the projects already ask for `openid profile` (`docs/architecture.md`, Roblox step), and R3147003 already reads `preferred_username` from the token's `user_metadata` for the username prompt. What to build: 1. Widen `LinkedIdentity` with optional display fields (e.g. `username?: string`, `avatarUrl?: string`), read from `identity_data`, kept only when they are non-empty strings. Accept an avatar only as an `https:` URL on Roblox's image host. This is display only and decides nothing. 2. In the Roblox row, once linked, show `@` (and the display name if it differs, if that reads well) and the headshot at a small fixed size. The size is a named constant (CLAUDE.md rule 9), the image gets empty `alt` text since the username beside it names it, and `loading="lazy"` is on. If the image fails to load or there is no URL, show nothing and don't leave a broken-image box. With no username, keep today's row. 3. **CSP:** `apps/web/public/_headers` has `img-src 'self' data: blob:`, which blocks Roblox's CDN. Add Roblox's headshot host there (likely `https://tr.rbxcdn.com`; confirm it against the real `picture` value) and nothing broader. Keep `apps/web/src/net/cloudflare-config.test.ts` green. If the host can't be pinned to one exact name, ship the username alone and note the avatar as a follow-up, instead of opening `img-src` to a wildcard. 4. Other providers' rows are unchanged. The same mechanism may show Google's identity too, but that is out of scope unless it comes free. 5. Add a ruling note in this issue's block (`spec/rulings/R.md`) for what the row shows and where it comes from, with its §11 paragraph in `spec/pending/.md` (CLAUDE.md rule 3). Name the tests after it. ### Acceptance - `identitiesOf` keeps `username` and `avatarUrl` from a Roblox identity's `identity_data`. It drops a non-string, empty or non-`https:` value, and an avatar URL on any other host (unit test in `apps/web/src/net/auth-methods.test.ts` or beside it, titled with the new R-id). - `LinkedAccounts.test.tsx`: a linked Roblox identity with both fields shows its username and an `` with that `src`. One with only a username shows the username and no image. One with neither shows today's row. An unlinked Roblox row shows neither. An image whose `error` fires is removed. - `apps/web/public/_headers`' `img-src` names exactly the one added Roblox image host, and `cloudflare-config.test.ts` passes. - The new ruling note exists, lists its tests in `proven_in`, and `cargo jackioh spec check` passes. - `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck`, `pnpm --dir apps/web test` and `pnpm exec eslint apps/web` pass. ### Blocked by, part of Follows R3147000 (Roblox sign-in), R3025000 (linking on `/account`) and R3147003 (the username prompt's use of `preferred_username`). ## Plan _Written by `muse` (muse, `muse-spark-1.3-contributor`, medium) ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/42669109821)) before anyone built this. The night bot's builder starts from this section: edit it here to change the plan._ ## Goal Today `/account`'s Roblox row (`apps/web/src/auth/LinkedAccounts.tsx`) says only that Roblox (`custom:roblox`) is linked. Done means a linked Roblox identity also shows **which** account it is: `@` from `identity_data.preferred_username`, with the display name (`name`/`nickname`) when it differs, and the headshot from `identity_data.picture` at a small fixed size when Roblox gives a usable URL. `identitiesOf` (`apps/web/src/net/auth.ts`) keeps these display-only fields, gated strictly (non-empty strings; avatar only as `https:` on Roblox's one image host). `img-src` in `apps/web/public/_headers` names exactly that host, and ruling `R3507000` records the row with its tests. ## Files to touch | File | New / change | What changes | |---|---|---| | `apps/web/src/net/auth.ts` | change | `LinkedIdentity` gains `username?`, `displayName?`, `avatarUrl?`; new exported `ROBLOX_AVATAR_IMAGE_HOST`; `identitiesOf` reads `identity_data` for `custom:roblox` only | | `apps/web/src/auth/LinkedAccounts.tsx` | change | New `LINKED_ROBLOX_AVATAR_PX`; new `linkedTestid.identity` / `linkedTestid.avatar`; Roblox row renders handle plus `` with error-hiding | | `apps/web/public/_headers` | change | `img-src` gains exactly `https://tr.rbxcdn.com` | | `apps/web/src/net/cloudflare-config.test.ts` | change | `CSP` const gains the host; `R2983000` sources expectation and a new `img-src` assertion | | `apps/web/src/net/auth-methods.test.ts` | change | New `R3507000` unit tests for `identitiesOf` | | `apps/web/src/auth/LinkedAccounts.test.tsx` | change | `serve` helper accepts `identity_data`; new `R3507000` component tests | | `spec/rulings/R3507000.md` | new | The ruling note, `proven_in` listing both test files | | `spec/pending/3507.md` | new | The §11 paragraph for `R3507000` | Do not touch: `.github/`, `.harness/`, `.squishy/`, `bot/`; `crates/*`, `apps/edge`, `e2e`, `apps/web/src/wire/`; other providers' rows; no CSS file. Governing spec: §9.2 and rulings `R666`, `R3025000`, `R3147000`, `R3147003`. ## Steps 1. Re-read `spec/09-architecture.md` §9.2, `spec/rulings/R3025000.md`, `spec/rulings/R3147000.md`, `spec/rulings/R3147003.md`, and `apps/web/src/auth/claims.ts` (the non-empty-string-or-null pattern to copy). 2. In `apps/web/src/net/auth.ts`, above `identitiesOf`: add `export const ROBLOX_AVATAR_IMAGE_HOST = "tr.rbxcdn.com";` (client-names-its-own-numbers precedent: `GIS_SCRIPT_URL` in `auth/googleIdentity.ts`). Widen the type to `export type LinkedIdentity = { id: string; provider: string; username?: string; displayName?: string; avatarUrl?: string };` with an `R3507000` comment. 3. In the same file, extend `identitiesOf`: only when `record.provider === "custom:roblox"`, read `record.identity_data` as an object; `username` is its `preferred_username` trimmed, kept only when non-empty; `displayName` is its `name` trimmed else its `nickname` trimmed, kept only when non-empty; `avatarUrl` is its `picture` kept only when it parses via `new URL`, has protocol `https:`, and its hostname equals `ROBLOX_AVATAR_IMAGE_HOST` (malformed URLs rejected by `try/catch`, mirroring the file's tolerant style). Set each field only when kept. Other providers keep exactly `{ id, provider }`. 4. In `apps/web/src/net/auth-methods.test.ts`, add `describe("R3507000 a linked Roblox identity keeps its username and headshot")`: keeps trimmed `preferred_username` plus `displayName` from `name` (else `nickname`) plus `avatarUrl` for `https://tr.rbxcdn.com/…picture`; drops a non-string, empty, or whitespace-only username; drops an avatar that is non-`https:`, on another host, or malformed; ignores `identity_data` on a `google` identity. 5. Run `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/net/auth-methods.test.ts`; all green before continuing. 6. In `apps/web/src/auth/LinkedAccounts.tsx`: add `const LINKED_ROBLOX_AVATAR_PX = 32;` beside the component (precedent: `OAUTH_MARK_PX` in `OAuthButtons.tsx`) and `identity: "account-linked-identity"`, `avatar: "account-linked-avatar"` in `linkedTestid`. Add a `RobloxIdentity` subcomponent taking `{ username?: string; avatarUrl?: string; displayName?: string }` with `const [failed, setFailed] = useState(false)`; it returns `null` when there is no username and no working avatar, else a `

` holding the `` (only when `avatarUrl` is set and `!failed`: `src={avatarUrl} alt="" loading="lazy" width={LINKED_ROBLOX_AVATAR_PX} height={LINKED_ROBLOX_AVATAR_PX} onError={() => { setFailed(true); }} data-testid={linkedTestid.avatar}`) and the handle text: `` `@${username}` ``, or `` `${displayName} (@${username})` `` when `displayName` is set and differs from `username` by exact comparison. The handle is a proper noun, so build it without `t()`. Render `` inside the Roblox row only, below the existing linked sentence (which stays word-for-word), when `identity.provider === "custom:roblox"` and at least one display field is set. Comment each addition with `R3507000`. 7. In `apps/web/src/auth/LinkedAccounts.test.tsx`: widen `serve` entries to `{ identity_id: string; provider: string; identity_data?: Record }`. Add `describe("R3507000 the linked Roblox account's username and headshot")` with `VITE_AUTH_OAUTH_PROVIDERS` stubbed to `"google,custom:roblox"`: linked Roblox with username plus `https://tr.rbxcdn.com` picture shows `@Builderman` and an `` with that `src`, empty `alt`, and `loading="lazy"`; username alone shows the handle and no image; neither shows today's row only (no identity or avatar testid); an unlinked Roblox row shows neither; `fireEvent.error` on the image removes it. 8. Run `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/auth/LinkedAccounts.test.tsx`; all green before continuing. 9. In `apps/web/public/_headers` line 10, change `img-src 'self' data: blob:` to `img-src 'self' data: blob: https://tr.rbxcdn.com`. In `apps/web/src/net/cloudflare-config.test.ts`, make the identical change in the `CSP` const; in the `R2983000` test, extend the `sources` expectation to ` [GIS_SCRIPT_URL, GOOGLE_IDENTITY_SOURCE, "https://tr.rbxcdn.com", GOOGLE_IDENTITY_SOURCE]` (directive order: script, style, img, frame) and add `expect(directive("img-src")).toEqual(["'self'", "data:", "blob:", "https://tr.rbxcdn.com"]);`. 10. Run `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/net/cloudflare-config.test.ts`. 11. Write `spec/rulings/R3507000.md` (front matter `id: R3507000`, title `The account screen names the linked Roblox account`, `cards: "§9.2, R3025000, R3147000"`, `proven_in` listing `apps/web/src/net/auth-methods.test.ts` and `apps/web/src/auth/LinkedAccounts.test.tsx`; body with `[[R3025000]]`, `[[R3147000]]`, `[[§9.2]]` links: the row shows `@username` from `identity_data.preferred_username` plus the display name when it differs, and the headshot from `identity_data.picture` on Roblox's image host; display only, decides nothing; CSP `img-src` names exactly that host; other providers unchanged). Write `spec/pending/3507.md` as one paragraph in the style of the other pending files: `**[[R3507000]] … (issue #3507, 2026-11-09)**: …`. 12. Run `cargo jackioh spec check`, `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck`, `pnpm exec eslint apps/web`, and `cargo fmt --check`. ## Tests - `apps/web/src/net/auth-methods.test.ts`, new `describe("R3507000 …")`: keeps username/displayName/avatar from a Roblox `identity_data`; drops non-string, empty, non-`https:`, wrong-host, and malformed values; ignores `identity_data` for other providers. Command: `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/net/auth-methods.test.ts`. - `apps/web/src/auth/LinkedAccounts.test.tsx`, new `describe("R3507000 …")`: handle plus `` with both fields; handle without image with username alone; today's row with neither; nothing on an unlinked row; image removed on `error`. Command: `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/auth/LinkedAccounts.test.tsx`. - `apps/web/src/net/cloudflare-config.test.ts` (updated `CSP` const, `R2983000` sources, new `img-src` assertion). Command: `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/net/cloudflare-config.test.ts`. ## Done when - `identitiesOf` keeps the three display fields with the stated gating, and drops each bad value. - The Roblox row shows the handle and headshot per the matrix above; other providers' rows are byte-for-byte today's behavior. - `_headers` `img-src` names exactly the one added host and `cloudflare-config.test.ts` passes. - `R3507000.md` exists, lists its tests in `proven_in`, `pending/3507.md` holds the §11 paragraph, and `spec check` passes. - `typecheck`, the three web test files, `eslint apps/web`, and `fmt --check` pass. ## Risks - The real `identity_data` claim names or picture host may differ from the task's stated values; the parser only accepts the known shape and otherwise renders today's row, so a mismatch degrades to no display, never a broken box. A person with a linked staging account confirms the names (see Open questions). - The `R2983000` test asserts the exact cross-directive `https:` source list, so any CSP edit must update it in the same change (step 9 does). - Usernames render as React text, never markup, so the no-raw-HTML scan is unaffected; the fields are display-only per rule 7 and decide nothing. ## Open questions - Staging confirmation needs a person: someone with a Roblox-linked staging account should compare a real `identity_data` against `preferred_username` / `name` / `nickname` / `picture` and the `tr.rbxcdn.com` host. If the host differs, a follow-up changes `ROBLOX_AVATAR_IMAGE_HOST`, `_headers`, and the tests together. If the host cannot be pinned to one exact name, per the task the builder ships the username alone and leaves the avatar as a follow-up rather than opening `img-src` to a wildcard. - Rejected alternatives: a wildcard or multi-host `img-src`; reading `identity_data` for Google too (out of scope, gated to `custom:roblox`); always showing the display name even when identical to the username. ```

Done means a linked Roblox identity also shows **which** account it is: `@` from `identity_data.preferred_username`, with the display name (`name`/`nickname`) when it differs, and the headshot from `identity_data.picture` at a small fixed size when Roblox gives a usable URL. `identitiesOf` (`apps/web/src/net/auth.ts`) keeps these display-only fields, gated strictly (non-empty strings; avatar only as `https:` on Roblox's one image host). `img-src` in `apps/web/public/_headers` names exactly that host, and ruling `R3507000` records the row with its tests. ## Files to touch | File | New / change | What changes | |---|---|---| | `apps/web/src/net/auth.ts` | change | `LinkedIdentity` gains `username?`, `displayName?`, `avatarUrl?`; new exported `ROBLOX_AVATAR_IMAGE_HOST`; `identitiesOf` reads `identity_data` for `custom:roblox` only | | `apps/web/src/auth/LinkedAccounts.tsx` | change | New `LINKED_ROBLOX_AVATAR_PX`; new `linkedTestid.identity` / `linkedTestid.avatar`; Roblox row renders handle plus `` with error-hiding | | `apps/web/public/_headers` | change | `img-src` gains exactly `https://tr.rbxcdn.com` | | `apps/web/src/net/cloudflare-config.test.ts` | change | `CSP` const gains the host; `R2983000` sources expectation and a new `img-src` assertion | | `apps/web/src/net/auth-methods.test.ts` | change | New `R3507000` unit tests for `identitiesOf` | | `apps/web/src/auth/LinkedAccounts.test.tsx` | change | `serve` helper accepts `identity_data`; new `R3507000` component tests | | `spec/rulings/R3507000.md` | new | The ruling note, `proven_in` listing both test files | | `spec/pending/3507.md` | new | The §11 paragraph for `R3507000` | Do not touch: `.github/`, `.harness/`, `.squishy/`, `bot/`; `crates/*`, `apps/edge`, `e2e`, `apps/web/src/wire/`; other providers' rows; no CSS file. Governing spec: §9.2 and rulings `R666`, `R3025000`, `R3147000`, `R3147003`. ## Steps 1. Re-read `spec/09-architecture.md` §9.2, `spec/rulings/R3025000.md`, `spec/rulings/R3147000.md`, `spec/rulings/R3147003.md`, and `apps/web/src/auth/claims.ts` (the non-empty-string-or-null pattern to copy). 2. In `apps/web/src/net/auth.ts`, above `identitiesOf`: add `export const ROBLOX_AVATAR_IMAGE_HOST = "tr.rbxcdn.com";` (client-names-its-own-numbers precedent: `GIS_SCRIPT_URL` in `auth/googleIdentity.ts`). Widen the type to `export type LinkedIdentity = { id: string; provider: string; username?: string; displayName?: string; avatarUrl?: string };` with an `R3507000` comment. 3. In the same file, extend `identitiesOf`: only when `record.provider === "custom:roblox"`, read `record.identity_data` as an object; `username` is its `preferred_username` trimmed, kept only when non-empty; `displayName` is its `name` trimmed else its `nickname` trimmed, kept only when non-empty; `avatarUrl` is its `picture` kept only when it parses via `new URL`, has protocol `https:`, and its hostname equals `ROBLOX_AVATAR_IMAGE_HOST` (malformed URLs rejected by `try/catch`, mirroring the file's tolerant style). Set each field only when kept. Other providers keep exactly `{ id, provider }`. 4. In `apps/web/src/net/auth-methods.test.ts`, add `describe("R3507000 a linked Roblox identity keeps its username and headshot")`: keeps trimmed `preferred_username` plus `displayName` from `name` (else `nickname`) plus `avatarUrl` for `https://tr.rbxcdn.com/…picture`; drops a non-string, empty, or whitespace-only username; drops an avatar that is non-`https:`, on another host, or malformed; ignores `identity_data` on a `google` identity. 5. Run `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/net/auth-methods.test.ts`; all green before continuing. 6. In `apps/web/src/auth/LinkedAccounts.tsx`: add `const LINKED_ROBLOX_AVATAR_PX = 32;` beside the component (precedent: `OAUTH_MARK_PX` in `OAuthButtons.tsx`) and `identity: "account-linked-identity"`, `avatar: "account-linked-avatar"` in `linkedTestid`. Add a `RobloxIdentity` subcomponent taking `{ username?: string; avatarUrl?: string; displayName?: string }` with `const [failed, setFailed] = useState(false)`; it returns `null` when there is no username and no working avatar, else a `

` holding the `` (only when `avatarUrl` is set and `!failed`: `src={avatarUrl} alt="" loading="lazy" width={LINKED_ROBLOX_AVATAR_PX} height={LINKED_ROBLOX_AVATAR_PX} onError={() => { setFailed(true); }} data-testid={linkedTestid.avatar}`) and the handle text: `` `@${username}` ``, or `` `${displayName} (@${username})` `` when `displayName` is set and differs from `username` by exact comparison. The handle is a proper noun, so build it without `t()`. Render `` inside the Roblox row only, below the existing linked sentence (which stays word-for-word), when `identity.provider === "custom:roblox"` and at least one display field is set. Comment each addition with `R3507000`. 7. In `apps/web/src/auth/LinkedAccounts.test.tsx`: widen `serve` entries to `{ identity_id: string; provider: string; identity_data?: Record }`. Add `describe("R3507000 the linked Roblox account's username and headshot")` with `VITE_AUTH_OAUTH_PROVIDERS` stubbed to `"google,custom:roblox"`: linked Roblox with username plus `https://tr.rbxcdn.com` picture shows `@Builderman` and an `` with that `src`, empty `alt`, and `loading="lazy"`; username alone shows the handle and no image; neither shows today's row only (no identity or avatar testid); an unlinked Roblox row shows neither; `fireEvent.error` on the image removes it. 8. Run `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/auth/LinkedAccounts.test.tsx`; all green before continuing. 9. In `apps/web/public/_headers` line 10, change `img-src 'self' data: blob:` to `img-src 'self' data: blob: https://tr.rbxcdn.com`. In `apps/web/src/net/cloudflare-config.test.ts`, make the identical change in the `CSP` const; in the `R2983000` test, extend the `sources` expectation to ` [GIS_SCRIPT_URL, GOOGLE_IDENTITY_SOURCE, "https://tr.rbxcdn.com", GOOGLE_IDENTITY_SOURCE]` (directive order: script, style, img, frame) and add `expect(directive("img-src")).toEqual(["'self'", "data:", "blob:", "https://tr.rbxcdn.com"]);`. 10. Run `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/net/cloudflare-config.test.ts`. 11. Write `spec/rulings/R3507000.md` (front matter `id: R3507000`, title `The account screen names the linked Roblox account`, `cards: "§9.2, R3025000, R3147000"`, `proven_in` listing `apps/web/src/net/auth-methods.test.ts` and `apps/web/src/auth/LinkedAccounts.test.tsx`; body with `[[R3025000]]`, `[[R3147000]]`, `[[§9.2]]` links: the row shows `@username` from `identity_data.preferred_username` plus the display name when it differs, and the headshot from `identity_data.picture` on Roblox's image host; display only, decides nothing; CSP `img-src` names exactly that host; other providers unchanged). Write `spec/pending/3507.md` as one paragraph in the style of the other pending files: `**[[R3507000]] … (issue #3507, 2026-11-09)**: …`. 12. Run `cargo jackioh spec check`, `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck`, `pnpm exec eslint apps/web`, and `cargo fmt --check`. ## Tests - `apps/web/src/net/auth-methods.test.ts`, new `describe("R3507000 …")`: keeps username/displayName/avatar from a Roblox `identity_data`; drops non-string, empty, non-`https:`, wrong-host, and malformed values; ignores `identity_data` for other providers. Command: `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/net/auth-methods.test.ts`. - `apps/web/src/auth/LinkedAccounts.test.tsx`, new `describe("R3507000 …")`: handle plus `` with both fields; handle without image with username alone; today's row with neither; nothing on an unlinked row; image removed on `error`. Command: `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/auth/LinkedAccounts.test.tsx`. - `apps/web/src/net/cloudflare-config.test.ts` (updated `CSP` const, `R2983000` sources, new `img-src` assertion). Command: `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/net/cloudflare-config.test.ts`. ## Done when - `identitiesOf` keeps the three display fields with the stated gating, and drops each bad value. - The Roblox row shows the handle and headshot per the matrix above; other providers' rows are byte-for-byte today's behavior. - `_headers` `img-src` names exactly the one added host and `cloudflare-config.test.ts` passes. - `R3507000.md` exists, lists its tests in `proven_in`, `pending/3507.md` holds the §11 paragraph, and `spec check` passes. - `typecheck`, the three web test files, `eslint apps/web`, and `fmt --check` pass. ## Risks - The real `identity_data` claim names or picture host may differ from the task's stated values; the parser only accepts the known shape and otherwise renders today's row, so a mismatch degrades to no display, never a broken box. A person with a linked staging account confirms the names (see Open questions). - The `R2983000` test asserts the exact cross-directive `https:` source list, so any CSP edit must update it in the same change (step 9 does). - Usernames render as React text, never markup, so the no-raw-HTML scan is unaffected; the fields are display-only per rule 7 and decide nothing. ## Open questions - Staging confirmation needs a person: someone with a Roblox-linked staging account should compare a real `identity_data` against `preferred_username` / `name` / `nickname` / `picture` and the `tr.rbxcdn.com` host. If the host differs, a follow-up changes `ROBLOX_AVATAR_IMAGE_HOST`, `_headers`, and the tests together. If the host cannot be pinned to one exact name, per the task the builder ships the username alone and leaves the avatar as a follow-up rather than opening `img-src` to a wildcard. - Rejected alternatives: a wildcard or multi-host `img-src`; reading `identity_data` for Google too (out of scope, gated to `custom:roblox`); always showing the display name even when identical to the username.
